summary: Took the orchestrator's option (a): a hidden piece plate now carries a predicted rect, so a sortie's clearOfPlate sees where the plate will stand and parks once, clear of it.

findings.detail: src/renderer/src/chart/labels.ts: new Label.predicted, set each frame in the hidden branch for a piece (labelOnHover) with a non-vertical holo plate, as the first holoCandidates rect from the same anchor and direction the placement uses (size: measured w/h, else PREDICT_W x PREDICT_H = 190x56). rectOf returns predicted while the plate is hidden, else the placed rect. No change to commands.ts or the maneuvers; the ship still picks once.

checks.name: e2e solar-dense (all 20, incl. 'a captain's turn' 22 B9)

limitations: The prediction is the plate's first-choice place; if the live placement later takes another because of a collision, the ship may be over it. The 5% bound held in the run. Unmeasured plates use a 190x56 estimate.
The full npm run e2e was not run (orchestrator's step before handing back); solar and solar-play specs were not re-run after this change.
